title: Grant admin role to current account and fix access denied

requirements.text: Modify the backend to automatically grant admin privileges to the currently authenticated user's principal ID when they access any admin endpoint
acceptanceCriteria: Current logged-in user has admin access without manual intervention
Admin role is persisted across sessions
No other user accounts are affected

requirements.text: Remove the access denied state from AdminGuard component by ensuring the isAdmin check passes for the current user

quotes: Remove access denied for admin page

acceptanceCriteria: AdminGuard component allows access to admin dashboard
No 'Access Denied' screen is shown for the current user

constraints: Do not modify any files or features outside of admin access control
Do not change the admin dashboard UI or worker review functionality
Do not alter worker registration, categories, or homepage content
nonGoals: Modifying admin dashboard layout or components
